title: Cosmic Serpent Embrace
description: A dark-skinned figure with golden facial patterns and glowing yellow eyes stands beside a tall, pale white humanoid with horns and long eyelashes. A large teal serpent with intricate spiral patterns and multiple eyes coils around both figures against a cosmic background filled with galaxies, stars, and floating feathers.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a bald dark-skinned figure with intricate golden patterns and glowing yellow eyes standing next to a tall faceless white humanoid with horns and dramatic eyelashes. A large intricate teal serpent with spiral designs and multiple eyes coils around both characters. The background is a vibrant purple and blue galaxy filled with stars, nebulae, and floating feathers. Mystical and symbolic atmosphere.
